steps.title: Donor lifetime
steps.text: Set the donor-only lifetime in ns.

steps.title: Förster radius
steps.text: Set R0 in Å for the donor/acceptor pair.

steps.title: Distance
steps.text: Enter donor–acceptor distance in Å; efficiency, lifetime and transfer rate update together.

steps.title: Inverse calculation
steps.text: Edit efficiency to solve the effective single distance. Broad distribution averages are not exactly invertible.

steps.title: Distribution width
steps.text: Set the width of the distance distribution in Å and inspect both plots.

steps.title: HomoFRET
steps.text: The HomoFRET tab links migration and rotational correlation time to distance. The rate is read-only.
